name: Congrega
tagline: The operating system for the modern congregation.
positioning: Congrega consolidates membership, giving, and service planning into one governed platform for pastors and lay leaders who run lean.

hero.h1: Run your whole congregation from one console.
hero.sub: Congrega replaces the binder, the spreadsheet, and the shoebox of offering envelopes with a single system of record built for solo pastors and volunteer boards.

features.title: Unified member ledger
features.description: Every family record, baptism date, and pastoral note lives in one governed profile — no more reconciling three directories before the annual meeting.

features.title: Giving that reconciles itself
features.description: Log offerings, online gifts, and pledges, then export a board-ready contribution statement in seconds. Year-end tax receipts generate in one click.

features.title: Service planning console
features.description: Build the order of worship, assign readings, and lock volunteer slots on one timeline that syncs to every leader's phone by Saturday night.

features.title: Volunteer rostering
features.description: Auto-fill greeters, ushers, and nursery shifts against availability, then send confirmations without a single group text thread.

features.title: Congregation-wide messaging
features.description: Send the weekly bulletin, prayer chain, and closure notices from one composer with delivery receipts and unsubscribe compliance built in.

features.title: Governance-grade reporting
features.description: Membership trends, attendance, and stewardship dashboards formatted for elder boards and denominational filings alike.

testimonials.quote: I used to spend the first week of January rebuilding contribution statements by hand. Congrega generated all 214 in under a minute, and every figure matched the ledger.
testimonials.name: Pastor Daniel Voss

testimonials.quote: Our volunteer schedule lived in a shared doc that three people edited at once. Congrega gave us one authoritative roster, and the no-shows basically stopped.
testimonials.name: Marisol Reyes

testimonials.quote: As a bivocational pastor, I don't have an office manager. Congrega is the office manager. The Sunday morning console alone earns its keep.
testimonials.name: Rev. Aaron Whitfield

pricing.blurb: For solo pastors and small fellowships establishing their first system of record.
For growing congregations coordinating volunteers, services, and staff.
For multi-site churches and networks with formal governance needs.

homepage.footerBlurb: Congrega is the governed operating system for congregations that run lean. One console for membership, giving, and worship — every Sunday accounted for.
